help.bookingProblemBody: Open it from “My bookings” and message us there. We see its details right away and will not ask for the booking number.

help.faqCancelAnswer: From “My bookings”, open the booking, then tap “Cancel”. It is free up to 4 hours before the appointment, then 25% is charged.

legal.title: Terms and privacy
legal.supportTitle: Have a question about your data?

privacy.summaryBody: We use your data for bookings only. We do not sell or share it, and your number is only visible to the place you booked with.
privacy.sectionOneBody: Your name, number, bookings, and selected city. Not your constant location or contacts.
privacy.sectionTwoBody: The place you book with sees your name and number to receive you. Reviews appear with your first name only.
privacy.sectionThreeBody: You can request a copy or deletion from inside the app, and we handle it within 30 days.

terms.summaryBody: Book with accurate details and respect the place’s appointment time. Cancellation and payment follow each service policy before confirmation.
terms.sectionOneBody: You can edit or cancel a booking in the app according to the service time and the place policy shown to you.
terms.sectionTwoBody: Payment is in person or online when available. Packages appear on your number and only move after confirming a number change.
terms.sectionThreeBody: Use the app for your personal bookings only, and tell us right away if something is wrong or inaccurate.
